name: Algorithmiq
description: Algorithmiq develops quantum algorithms for life sciences and drug discovery applications. The company focuses on quantum-enhanced computational methods for molecular simulations and pharmaceutical research. Founded in Helsinki, Algorithmiq moved its global headquarters to Milan in May 2026 following a EUR 18M funding round, bringing total funding to over EUR 36M.

news.title: Algorithmiq wins Wellcome Leap Q4Bio Challenge
news.excerpt: Algorithmiq won the $2 million Wellcome Leap Q4Bio Challenge, demonstrating progress in quantum algorithms for life sciences.

news.title: Algorithmiq raises €18M and moves global headquarters from Helsinki to Milan
news.excerpt: Algorithmiq closed a EUR 18M funding round — Italy's largest quantum VC investment to date — and relocated its global headquarters from Helsinki to Milan, bringing total funding to over EUR 36M.

news.title: Algorithmiq wins €1.7M Wellcome Leap Q4Bio prize for quantum-enabled cancer drug discovery
news.excerpt: Algorithmiq was awarded the $2M Wellcome Leap Q4Bio prize for a quantum-classical workflow simulating photosensitizer drug properties for photodynamic cancer therapy on a 100-qubit IBM quantum system.

news.title: Algorithmiq raises €18M and moves global headquarters from Helsinki to Milan
news.excerpt: United Ventures and CDP Venture Capital co-led a €18M round for Algorithmiq, bringing total funding to €36M. The company simultaneously relocated its global HQ from Helsinki to Milan — Italy's largest-ever VC investment in a quantum startup — citing proximity to European enterprise customers and institutional investors.

news.title: IBM and Algorithmiq demonstrate quantum advantage in trusted materials simulation beyond classical verification
news.excerpt: On July 30, 2026, IBM and Algorithmiq announced a joint framework for validating quantum computations when classical verification is unavailable, demonstrating quantum advantage in simulating a heterogeneous quantum material on IBM's Heron processors. Algorithmiq simultaneously released a new benchmark for quantum advantage claims.
